title: Stakeholder reaction
guidance: **Make-tangible closes here (gate D9 — Validation loop).** The prototype is not done when it is *built* — it is done when someone has *reacted* to it and that reaction is captured as evidence. Show `wireframe.html` to the people the problem statement names, record their reaction against each framing hypothesis, and log each reaction as a new signal so it feeds D2. Demo runs use **synthetic stakeholders** — tag them `[synthetic]`. Zero real PII.
